input_boundary: Extracted atomic facts and oracle candidates are supplied directly; extraction and retrieval are out of scope.
description: Second untouched reconciliation holdout for the frozen same-proposition policy. Run once and never tune against these cases.

cases.description: Decision wording does not rewrite an existing active emergency-fund goal.

fact.content: The user has decided to build a six-month emergency fund.
fact.evidence: I decided to build a six-month emergency fund

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to build a six-month emergency fund.

cases.description: A new explicit deadline materially updates the same goal.

fact.content: The user wants to finish the manuscript by March.
fact.evidence: I want the manuscript finished by March

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to finish a manuscript.

cases.description: Related but distinct value and preference remain separate.

fact.content: The user values environmental responsibility.
fact.evidence: Environmental responsibility matters to me

cases.description: Only the ended management relationship is invalidated.

fact.content: Maya is no longer the user's manager.
fact.evidence: Maya is no longer my manager

candidate_memories.content: Maya is the user's close friend.

cases.description: Two equivalent new decision facts create one memory.

fact.content: The user chose the evening program.
fact.evidence: I chose the evening program

fact.content: The user decided on the evening course.
fact.evidence: the evening course is my decision

cases.description: A location replacement and new preference do not interfere.

fact.content: The user now lives in Valencia.
fact.evidence: I now live in Valencia

fact.content: The user prefers studying early.
fact.evidence: I prefer studying early

cases.description: An ended sailing plan cannot invalidate a swimming goal.

fact.content: The user no longer plans to buy a sailboat.
fact.evidence: I backed out of buying the sailboat

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to improve at open-water swimming.

cases.description: Two existing facts remain NOOP despite different wording.

fact.content: The user values keeping commitments.
fact.evidence: Keeping my promises matters to me

candidate_memories.content: The user values following through on promises.

fact.content: The user prefers train travel for long journeys.
fact.evidence: I prefer taking trains for long trips

candidate_memories.content: The user likes traveling long distances by train.

cases.description: Overlapping scope details may update a shared goal once only.

fact.content: The user wants to complete the evening program without debt.
fact.evidence: I want to complete it without taking on debt

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to complete the evening program.

fact.content: Avoiding debt is part of the user's evening-program goal.
fact.evidence: without taking on debt

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to complete the evening program.

cases.description: Each invalidation selects its own local target.

fact.content: The user no longer wants to study law.
fact.evidence: Law school is no longer my goal

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to study medicine.
The user wants to study law.

fact.content: The user no longer prefers video calls.
fact.evidence: I no longer prefer video calls

cases.description: A four-fact batch preserves all action boundaries.

fact.content: The user wants to learn sign language.
fact.evidence: I want to learn sign language

fact.content: The user now prefers monthly reviews.
fact.evidence: I now prefer monthly reviews

fact.content: The user no longer plans to relocate to Oslo.
fact.evidence: I abandoned my plan to move to Oslo

candidate_memories.content: The user wants to relocate to Oslo.

fact.content: The user values patience.
fact.evidence: Patience remains important to me

candidate_memories.content: The user values patience with others.

cases.description: Two facts about the same person remain separate propositions.

fact.content: Omar is the user's neighbor.
fact.evidence: Omar is my neighbor

candidate_memories.content: The user organizes a festival with Omar.
